title: Friends Fitness Portal
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a floating classical building labeled 'Club4 Fitness' at the center, surrounded by glowing purple 'friends' bubbles containing gym interiors. In the foreground, a white-haired armored warrior stands on a rocky outcrop holding a large golden 'friends' ticket, set against swirling nebulae, a giant red planet, and dark twisted branches.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene with a classical white building labeled Club4 Fitness floating in space, surrounded by glowing purple circular portals and floating bubbles containing gym interior scenes, many labeled 'friends'. In the foreground a muscular white-haired warrior in dark armor stands on a rocky platform holding a large glowing golden ticket that says 'friends'. Background shows swirling purple and teal nebulae, a massive red cracked planet, and dark twisted branches, dramatic cinematic lighting, vibrant digital art.
